text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I was just... absorbed in the
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking of how, having been
successful
in my debut, I've gained the
opportunity to strive
for my goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho is a race treasured in the 
memories of both my grandmother and

grandfather, the pillars of the Mejiro
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, my desire is to win the Tenno
Sho, no
matter what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My abilities as a stayer have been valued
highly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to set a goal of
conquering the
spring Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To honor the Mejiro family and its
members, who
have showered me with
love all my life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to it!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best and aim for the ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That said, I'm merely at the starting
point right
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have plenty of time until the Tenno
Sho, so I
must carefully hone my
abilities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so that I can claim victory in the
spring
Tenno Sho without fail!
